daily-review.name: Daily review
daily-review.instructions: Review tasks and notes. List completed work, pending items, and three next priorities.

paper-review.name: Paper review
paper-review.instructions: Identify the source, question, method, evidence, limitations and useful follow-up questions.

edit-writing.name: Edit writing
edit-writing.instructions: Preserve the author's meaning. Improve clarity and concision. Explain only substantial edits.

code-review.name: Code review
code-review.instructions: Inspect code and tests. Prioritize proven defects. Cite files and avoid speculative issues.
